# Welcome to the Forest of Bowland National Landscape

## The Forest of Bowland National Landscape is one of 46 National Landscapes covering just under 1/5th of the UK.

National Landscapes have some of the UK’s best countryside for walking, cycling, wildlife-watching and star-gazing and Bowland is no different. From quiet lanes, ancient woodlands, distinctive and attractive villages to flower-filled hay meadows, open moorland and a wealth of local culture and heritage.

The Forest of Bowland National Landscape is a special place and important for its heather moorland, blanket bog and rare birds.
